authorizationMeaning: The owner approved starting the previously proposed next step: aesthetic calibration and three-direction concept prototyping before production UI changes.
taskMeaning: Create three comparable visual directions for the data-bound /v2/home route so the owner can select an aesthetic and information hierarchy with evidence before any implementation task is opened.
allowedActions: Read current SSOT, contracts, current /v2/home visual implementation, and visual-review evidence
Create three concept-only visual directions with the same masked demonstration dataset
Create desktop and mobile review views, design tokens, annotations, screenshots, and a human-selection handoff
Use Figma only after a target file is available and only as a design carrier; Figma output cannot satisfy human acceptance
forbiddenActions: Modify app/**, components/**, lib/**, types/**, package files, deployment configuration, or any production route
Modify ETL, BI formulas, Target formulas, persistence schema, search semantics, or metric definitions
Hide, remove, rename, or synthesize any of the 17 KPI
Expose raw rows, source filenames, order identifiers, refund identifiers, phone, address, logistics details, buyer notes, or merchant remarks
Deploy, push, replace legacy /home, or bind another V2 route
Set visualAccepted=true or humanAccepted=true without explicit owner selection and full-page review
requiredOutputs: permanent desktop and mobile screenshot evidence
stopRule: Stop after delivering the three-direction review package. Do not touch production UI until the owner chooses a direction and separately authorizes implementation.
